title: Three Readings
summary: A repeated-measures ANOVA: wide to long, afex's aov_ez(), Mauchly's test and the Greenhouse–Geisser correction, then paired follow-ups.
hints: `pivot_longer(starts_with("efficacy"), names_to = "time", values_to = "efficacy")` makes one row per teacher per time.
`aov_ez(id = "id", dv = "efficacy", data = long, within = "time")`. `summary(rm)$sphericity.tests` holds Mauchly's test; its p-value is in the `"p-value"` column.
`pairwise.t.test(long$efficacy, long$time, paired = TRUE, p.adjust.method = "holm")` compares the time points pair by pair.
